actions.what: rename control-medium-gap → control-medium-gap-inline adopted in code, old name kept as deprecated alias (confidence 0.92)

button-danger-bg-color-rest: code is right → Figma #f6f8fa → #ffebe9. The commit message explicitly states danger buttons should get a tinted background per design ticket DS-412; #ffebe9 is a red-tinted color matching that intent, while #f6f8fa is a neutral gray that does not signal danger.
button-invisible-fg-color-rest: both sides changed it → a person decides (Ultra leans Figma)

button-primary-bg-color-hover: code is right → Figma #1c8139 → #1a7f37. The commit message explicitly states the color was darkened to #1a7f37 to pass a 4.5:1 contrast audit; the Figma value #1c8139 is the lighter, failing predecessor.
6 Button bindings pointed at a token with a different value than code's → re-bound to the token the code uses
5 missing Button variants generated from the code's CSS, bound to Figma variables

pending: button-invisible-fg-color-rest: Figma #0969da vs code #59636e, both changed since last certification. Ultra leans Figma: The designer intentionally set invisible buttons to use the link/action blue for affordance; the engineer's fix addressed a table-specific clash but incorrectly changed the global token.
